definitions.explanation: A test where answers are written on paper, as opposed to an oral or practical exam. Common in school entrance exams, certification tests, and employment screenings in Japan.

examples.japanese: {筆記試験|ひっきしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{筆記試験|ひっきしけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a written exam before the interview.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転免許|うんてんめんきょ}→運転免許：15285_untenmenkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆記試験|ひっきしけん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{実技試験|じつぎしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}から→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: To get a driver's license, you must pass both the written and practical exams.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{筆記|ひっき}→筆記：00101_hikki⟧ (writing) + ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (exam). A test where answers are written by hand, as opposed to oral or practical exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆記試験|ひっきしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take a written exam
- {筆記試験|ひっきしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to pass a written exam
- {筆記試験|ひっきしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fail a written exam

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧: interview
- {口述試験|こうじゅつしけん}: oral exam
- {実技試験|じつぎしけん}: practical exam

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many hiring processes include a {筆記試験|ひっきしけん} covering general knowledge or aptitude (often the SPI test). ⟦{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}→入学試験：09258_nyuugakushiken⟧ (entrance exams) and {資格試験|しかくしけん} (certification tests) also typically have a written component.
